cells.gaps: The survey's 90% is adults financially included, largely through mobile money; its share holding a bank or mobile money account is not given separately. No survey found since November 2023 puts adults who made or received a digital payment at 79% or more.
cells.note: The Somalia Financial Access Survey 2026, nationally representative, finds 90% of adults financially included, largely through mobile money, four in five or more. No survey gives the share paying digitally.
